item.title: Imagine the SOC Without a Queue: From Alert Backlog to AI Hypothesis Engine
item.summary: The SOC we've always known was built around a model that guarantees most of the alert queue will never receive analyst review. There's never time. In a traditional SOC, the typical progression follows a well-known pattern: an alert arrives; a detection engine assigns a severity score.
